The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the core logic for risk assessment is functional.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across 1 trial with zero exceptions recorded in the harbor job info. Pytest 8.4.1 successfully validated the implementation via test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite in 0.33 seconds. While the verifier reward is maximum, the judge reward of 0.73 suggests potential for improvement in code documentation or edge-case handling.
